_comment: Flex ISSUE DATABASE — committed, synced via git, shown+edited in the control panel's Issues dashboard. Suite gate: status informed/acknowledged/false-flag → matching failed checks are demoted to tagged info (a red run always means something NEW); status new → still fails; fixed → fails again if it reappears. The panel auto-appends newly-seen issues as status 'new' (or 'candidate' for exploratory finds) but NEVER auto-demotes — only a human changes a status. See flex/configs/issueDb.ts. Cleared to a fresh slate 2026-07-20; the next regression re-populates it.
